about.en:
nwHacks 2027 is Western Canada's largest student hackathon, run by nwPlus at the University of British Columbia. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at UBC Life Sciences Institute in Vancouver from 2027-01-16 to 2027-01-17. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.

summary.en: The oldest and most prestigious science research competition for US high-school seniors, with about $3.1 million in awards and a $250,000 top prize. Applications for the 2027 competition close on 5 November 2026.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის საშუალო სკოლის დამამთავრებელი კლასის მოსწავლეებისთვის ყველაზე ძველი და პრესტიჟული სამეცნიერო-კვლევითი კონკურსი, დაახლოებით 3,1 მილიონი დოლარის ჯილდოებით და 250,000 დოლარის მთავარი პრიზით. 2027 წლის კონკურსზე განაცხადების მიღება 2026 წლის 5 ნოემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: أعرق وأرقى مسابقة للبحث العلمي لطلاب السنة الأخيرة من المرحلة الثانوية في الولايات المتحدة، بجوائز تقارب 3.1 مليون دولار وجائزة أولى قدرها 250,000 دولار. ويُغلق باب التقديم لمسابقة 2027 في 5 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Regeneron STS, run by Society for Science since 1942, recognises original independent research by high-school seniors. Applicants submit a full research report plus essays, recommendations and transcripts through an online application.

The top 300 scholars are announced on 7 January 2027 (each receives $2,000, with $2,000 for their school); the top 40 finalists, announced 21 January 2027, travel to Washington, D.C. for Finals Week on 11–17 March 2027, with a public exhibition on 14 March and the awards ceremony on 16 March.

It is one of the strongest signals a US applicant can show to top universities, and finalists' travel and expenses are covered.

en: ~$3.1 million in awards; $250,000 first prize
Top 40 finalists flown to Washington, D.C. (11–17 March 2027)
Free to apply

eligibility.en: High-school seniors in the US and its territories, and US citizens attending school abroad, in their final year of secondary school. Research must be the student's own work. Check the official rules for full eligibility.

en: Finish your independent research project and write the research report
Create an account on the Society for Science application portal
Complete essays, upload transcript and recommendations
Submit before 5 November 2026, 8 pm ET

costs.en: Free to enter. Finalists' travel and lodging for Finals Week are paid by the organiser.

about.en:
Jugend forscht invites young people to pick their own research question in seven fields (working world, biology, chemistry, earth and space sciences, mathematics/informatics, physics, technology) and present it at a regional contest, then the state and national rounds. There are two age groups: 'Schüler experimentieren' (Jugend forscht junior, 4th grade to 14) and Jugend forscht (15–21).

You register online by 30 November 2026, then submit a written report in January and present at a regional contest in February/March 2027. National winners can represent Germany at the EU Contest for Young Scientists and other international fairs.

The competition is in German and aimed at students living or studying in Germany (including German schools abroad).

en: Germany's biggest youth science contest
Path to national final and EUCYS
Individual or teams of up to three

eligibility.en: Young people from 4th grade up to age 21 who attend school, an apprenticeship or university in Germany, or a German school abroad; individuals or teams of up to three. German-language project work.

en: Choose your research question and a supervising teacher/mentor
Register online by 30 November 2026
Write up your project (written work due in January)
Present at your regional contest in Feb/Mar 2027

costs.en: Free to enter; regional, state and national contests are free for participants.

score_reason: Major national science fair with EUCYS pathway; Germany-based students only

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2026 cycle (tasks from 1 Dec, submission by 2 Mar); confirm 2027 dates on the official site

summary.en: Germany's national take-home mathematics competition: four olympiad-style problems with two to three months to solve them. First-round problems are released in December and solutions are due in early March.
summary.ka: გერმანიის ეროვნული მათემატიკური კონკურსი სახლში ამოსახსნელი ამოცანებით: ოთხი ოლიმპიადური ამოცანა და ორ-სამი თვე ამოსახსნელად. პირველი ტურის ამოცანები დეკემბერში ქვეყნდება, ამოხსნები კი მარტის დასაწყისში უნდა ჩაბარდეს.
summary.ar: المسابقة الوطنية الألمانية للرياضيات بنظام الحل في المنزل: أربع مسائل على طراز الأولمبياد مع شهرين إلى ثلاثة أشهر لحلها. تُنشر مسائل الجولة الأولى في ديسمبر وتُسلَّم الحلول في أوائل مارس.

about.en:
The Bundeswettbewerb Mathematik has three rounds. Rounds 1 and 2 each give four problems in geometry, combinatorics, number theory or algebra, solved at home over two to three months; round 3 is an hour-long colloquium with mathematicians. Group work (up to three people) is allowed in round 1 only.

You need three correct solutions to win a prize and qualify for round 2. Federal winners are admitted to the German National Academic Foundation (Studienstiftung). Solutions are submitted by post, handwritten or typed, in German.

en: Take-home olympiad problems over ~3 months
Group work allowed in round 1
Federal winners join the Studienstiftung

eligibility.en: Students in any grade at a school in Germany leading to the Abitur, or at a German school abroad. Solutions in German.

en: Download the round-1 problems from December 2026
Solve at least one problem (three for a prize)
Register online once your work is ready
Post your solutions before the early-March deadline

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Respected free maths contest; limited to Germany-based students

name.en: International Mathematics Competition for University Students (IMC) 2027

deadline_note: Dates 2–9 August 2027 published on the official site; registration details 'will be added when ready' (usually via university team leaders in spring)

summary.en: The 34th International Mathematics Competition for undergraduates, held 2–9 August 2027. Students compete individually in two five-hour papers covering algebra, analysis, geometry and combinatorics.
summary.ka: 34-ე საერთაშორისო მათემატიკური კონკურსი ბაკალავრიატის სტუდენტებისთვის, 2027 წლის 2–9 აგვისტოს. სტუდენტები ინდივიდუალურად წერენ ორ ხუთსაათიან ნაშრომს ალგებრაში, ანალიზში, გეომეტრიასა და კომბინატორიკაში.
summary.ar: الدورة الـ34 من المسابقة الدولية للرياضيات لطلاب البكالوريوس، من 2 إلى 9 أغسطس 2027. يتنافس الطلاب فرديًا في ورقتين مدة كل منهما خمس ساعات تغطيان الجبر والتحليل والهندسة والتوافقيات.

about.en:
The IMC is the main international olympiad for university mathematics students, run since 1994 and traditionally hosted at the American University in Bulgaria, Blagoevgrad. Around 600 students from 200+ universities take part, usually as university teams with a team leader, though individuals may also register.

The competition has two days of problems; medals and honourable mentions are awarded. Check the IMC site for the 2027 venue confirmation, fees (registration covers accommodation and meals) and registration window.

en: Premier olympiad for undergraduates
Two five-hour problem papers
Teams from 200+ universities worldwide

eligibility.en: Undergraduate students (up to age ~23, per IMC rules) at any university worldwide; usually entered by their university's team leader.

en: Ask your mathematics department whether it sends a team
Watch the IMC 2027 registration page for the opening date
Register through your team leader (or individually)
Pay the participation fee and arrange travel/visa

costs.en: Participation fee covers accommodation and meals during the competition (amount published at registration); travel is self-funded or paid by universities.

score_reason: Key university maths olympiad; registration via universities

summary.ar: النسخة الأمريكية من مسابقة الكنغر الدولية للرياضيات للصفوف من الروضة حتى 12، وتُقام في مارس 2027 في مراكز اختبار محلية. والتسجيل مفتوح للدورة الثلاثين.

about.en:
Math Kangaroo is the US branch of the International Kangaroo competition, taken by millions of students in 90+ countries. It is a multiple-choice test of logical reasoning and problem solving, with separate levels for each grade pair.

The 2027 individual competition takes place in March 2027 at registered test centres across the US; all participants receive a commemorative gift for the 30th anniversary, and top scorers win awards and national rankings.

en: K–12 levels by grade
Part of the international Kangaroo (90+ countries)
Awards and national rankings

eligibility.en: Students in grades K–12 in the United States (outside the US, enter your country's own Kangaroo organiser).

en: Find a Math Kangaroo test centre near you on the website
Register and pay the fee online
Practise with past papers
Take the test in March 2027

costs.en: Registration fee per student (set by Math Kangaroo USA; see the registration page).

score_reason: Accessible, popular maths contest; US only

org: COMAP (Consortium for Mathematics and Its Applications)

name.ar: مسابقة HiMCM 2026 للنمذجة الرياضية لطلاب المدارس الثانوية

deadline_note: Contest window 4–17 Nov 2026; teams register on contest.comap.com before starting

summary.en: An international team contest where high-school students spend up to two weeks building a mathematical model of a real-world problem and writing it up. The 2026 window runs 4–17 November.
summary.ka: საერთაშორისო გუნდური კონკურსი, სადაც საშუალო სკოლის მოსწავლეები ორ კვირამდე დროში ქმნიან რეალური პრობლემის მათემატიკურ მოდელს და წერენ ანგარიშს. 2026 წლის ფანჯარა 4–17 ნოემბერია.
summary.ar: مسابقة دولية للفرق يقضي فيها طلاب المرحلة الثانوية ما يصل إلى أسبوعين في بناء نموذج رياضي لمشكلة واقعية وكتابة تقرير عنه. ونافذة 2026 من 4 إلى 17 نوفمبر.

about.en:
The High School Mathematical Contest in Modeling (HiMCM) is run by COMAP. Teams of up to four students, with a faculty advisor, choose one of the released problems and have any consecutive 14 days within the window to research, model and submit a solution paper.

Papers are judged on assumptions, modelling, analysis and clarity, and graded Outstanding, Finalist, Meritorious, Honorable Mention or Successful Participant. It is excellent preparation for the MCM/ICM and IMMC and looks strong on applications for maths, economics and engineering.

en: Teams of up to 4 with an advisor
Real-world open problems
Any 14 days inside 4–17 November

eligibility.en: Students in high-school grades or below, from any country; teams need a teacher/faculty advisor who registers them.

en: Ask a teacher to act as advisor
Advisor registers the team on contest.comap.com and pays the fee
Choose a problem when released and work for your chosen period
Submit the solution paper before the window closes

costs.en: Team registration fee paid by the advisor (see COMAP site).

summary.ar: أكبر مسابقة للنمذجة الرياضية في العالم لفرق طلاب الجامعات والمدارس الثانوية، تُعقد على مدى أربعة أيام من 28 يناير إلى 1 فبراير 2027. تحل فرق من ثلاثة أعضاء مشكلة واقعية مفتوحة وتقدّم تقريرًا.

about.en:
MCM (Mathematical Contest in Modeling) and ICM (Interdisciplinary Contest in Modeling) are run by COMAP. Tens of thousands of teams from around the world choose one of six problems (continuous, discrete, data insights, operations research, sustainability, policy) and have four days to build a model and write a solution paper.

Teams need a faculty advisor who registers them in advance. Results (Outstanding, Finalist, Meritorious, Honorable Mention) are well recognised by graduate programmes and employers in quantitative fields.

en: Teams of up to 3 with an advisor
Six problem types incl. policy and data
Huge global field; recognised results

eligibility.en: College/university undergraduates and high-school students worldwide; teams of up to three registered by a faculty advisor at their institution.

en: Find a faculty advisor at your school or university
Advisor registers the team on contest.comap.com and pays the fee before the contest
Download problems when the contest opens on 28 January
Submit your solution paper by the 1 February deadline

costs.en: Registration fee per team (paid by the advisor; see COMAP).

score_reason: Largest global modelling contest; open to all countries

summary.en: A free online series of olympiad-style programming contests run by the Croatian Informatics Society and open to students worldwide. Remaining 2026/27 rounds are on 14 November and 12 December 2026, 23 January and 20 February 2027.
summary.ka: უფასო ონლაინ ოლიმპიადური პროგრამირების შეჯიბრების სერია, რომელსაც ხორვატიის ინფორმატიკის საზოგადოება ატარებს და ღიაა მთელი მსოფლიოს მოსწავლეებისთვის. 2026/27 წლის დარჩენილი ტურებია 2026 წლის 14 ნოემბერი და 12 დეკემბერი, 2027 წლის 23 იანვარი და 20 თებერვალი.
summary.ar: سلسلة مجانية من مسابقات البرمجة على طراز الأولمبياد عبر الإنترنت تنظمها جمعية المعلوماتية الكرواتية ومفتوحة للطلاب حول العالم. والجولات المتبقية لموسم 2026/27 في 14 نوفمبر و12 ديسمبر 2026، و23 يناير و20 فبراير 2027.

about.en:
COCI is a long-running monthly-style contest series used by olympiad students around the world to train for national olympiads and the IOI. Each round is a three-hour online contest with several algorithmic problems in increasing difficulty, solved in C++, Python or other supported languages and judged automatically.

All rounds start at 14:00 UTC. Rankings are published per round and for the season; problems and test data are released afterwards for practice.

en: Free, online, open worldwide
IOI-style algorithmic problems
Season ranking across five rounds

eligibility.en: Open to anyone; aimed at secondary-school students preparing for informatics olympiads.

en: Create an account on the COCI/HSIN evaluator
Join each round at 14:00 UTC on the contest date
Solve as many problems as you can in three hours
Check results and upsolve with the published test data

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free global IOI-style training contest

about.en:
ACSL organises contests in several divisions by age and ability. Each contest has short-answer questions on computer-science topics (Boolean algebra, graph theory, data structures, bit-string flicking, etc.) and, in upper divisions, a programming problem in Python, C++ or Java.

Schools register teams and administer the contests during set windows; top students are invited to the online ACSL Finals at the end of the year. Schools in Brazil, China, Korea, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam register via national partners; everyone else uses the ACSL form.

Theory + programming problems
Online finals for top scorers

Pick the right division
Sit each contest in your school's window
Qualify for the end-of-year Finals

summary.en: The UK's national programming olympiad: a three-hour round sat in school in December–January, then a final in Cambridge that selects the UK team for the IOI.
summary.ka: გაერთიანებული სამეფოს ეროვნული პროგრამირების ოლიმპიადა: სამსაათიანი ტური სკოლაში დეკემბერ-იანვარში, შემდეგ ფინალი კემბრიჯში, სადაც IOI-სთვის ბრიტანეთის გუნდი შეირჩევა.

about.en:
The British Informatics Olympiad's first round is a three-hour programming exam taken at school under teacher supervision, in any programming language, with problems that mix coding and logical reasoning. Teachers register on the BIO site and mark papers using the provided scheme.

Top scorers are invited to the final at Churchill College, Cambridge (2026's ran 3–5 April), and the best finalists go on to the training camp that picks the UK team for the International Olympiad in Informatics.

en: Free three-hour round in school
Final at Churchill College, Cambridge
Pathway to the IOI

Sit round one in school during the Dec–Jan window
Await results and a possible final invitation
Attend the Cambridge final in spring

summary.ka: უფასო ლიტერატურული კონკურსი მსოფლიოს საშუალო სკოლის მოსწავლეებისთვის პროზაში, დოკუმენტურ პროზასა და პოეზიაში, 2,000 დოლარამდე ფულადი პრიზებით და Bennington-ში სწავლის დიდი სტიპენდიებით. ბოლო ვადა 1 ნოემბერია.

about.en:
The Bennington Young Writers Awards recognise outstanding writing by students in grades 9–12. Each student may enter one category: fiction (one story or excerpt), nonfiction (one personal or creative essay) or poetry (1–3 poems), each up to 1,500 words. Entries must be in English and approved by a sponsoring teacher or, for homeschoolers, a mentor.

Prizes: $2,000, $1,000 and $500 plus $250 for distinguished entries; winners who enrol at Bennington receive full-tuition (first place) or half-tuition scholarships, and finalists $25,000 a year. Grade-12 entrants must first submit a Common App or Coalition application indicating interest. AI-assisted entries are disqualified.

Cash prizes up to $2,000

eligibility.en: Students in grades 9–12 anywhere in the world, writing in English, sponsored by a teacher or mentor; one entry per student; seniors must have started a Common App/Coalition application.

summary.en: A free poetry prize from The Kenyon Review for high-school sophomores and juniors; the winner gets a full scholarship to a Kenyon Review Young Writers workshop and publication. Submissions are accepted 1–30 November.
summary.ka: The Kenyon Review-ის უფასო პოეტური პრემია საშუალო სკოლის მე-10 და მე-11 კლასელებისთვის; გამარჯვებული იღებს სრულ სტიპენდიას Kenyon Review-ის ახალგაზრდა მწერლების ვორქშოფზე და პუბლიკაციას. ნამუშევრები 1–30 ნოემბერს მიიღება.
summary.ar: جائزة شعرية مجانية من The Kenyon Review لطلاب الصفين العاشر والحادي عشر؛ ويحصل الفائز على منحة كاملة لورشة Kenyon Review للكتّاب الشباب وعلى نشر قصيدته. تُقبل المشاركات من 1 إلى 30 نوفمبر.

about.en:
The Patricia Grodd Poetry Prize is one of the best-known youth poetry awards in the US literary world. Students submit poems online during November; the winner and two runners-up are published in The Kenyon Review, a leading literary magazine.

The winner receives a full scholarship to a Kenyon Review Young Writers summer workshop (or an online workshop for past residential attendees). There is no entry fee and no stated country restriction.

en: Free to enter
Publication in The Kenyon Review
Full scholarship to the Young Writers workshop

eligibility.en: High-school sophomores and juniors (grades 10–11 or equivalent); no country restriction stated.

en: Prepare your poem(s) per the submission guidelines
Submit via kenyonreview.org/submit/patricia-grodd/ between 1 and 30 November

costs.en: Free to enter.

score_reason: Prestigious, free, window opens tomorrow

deadline_note: Entry via local and affiliate contests (winter–spring 2027); National Contest 13–17 June 2027 at the University of Maryland

summary.en: A year-long history research competition where students create papers, exhibits, documentaries, performances or websites on the 2027 theme 'Innovation in History: Impact, Influence, Change'. Winners of local and affiliate contests reach the National Contest on 13–17 June 2027.
summary.ka: მთელი წლის ისტორიული კვლევის კონკურსი, სადაც მოსწავლეები 2027 წლის თემაზე „ინოვაცია ისტორიაში: ზეგავლენა, გავლენა, ცვლილება“ ქმნიან ნაშრომებს, გამოფენებს, დოკუმენტურ ფილმებს, წარმოდგენებს ან ვებგვერდებს. ადგილობრივი და რეგიონული კონკურსების გამარჯვებულები 2027 წლის 13–17 ივნისის ეროვნულ ფინალზე გადიან.
summary.ar: مسابقة بحثية في التاريخ تمتد طوال العام، يُعدّ فيها الطلاب أبحاثًا أو معارض أو أفلامًا وثائقية أو عروضًا أو مواقع إلكترونية حول موضوع 2027 «الابتكار في التاريخ: الأثر والتأثير والتغيير». ويتأهل الفائزون في المسابقات المحلية والفرعية إلى النهائي الوطني من 13 إلى 17 يونيو 2027.

about.en:
National History Day engages over half a million students a year in primary-source historical research. Students work alone or in groups on a topic linked to the annual theme and present it in one of five categories: paper, exhibit, documentary, performance or website.

They first compete at school/local and affiliate (state or international) contests in spring; top entries advance to the National Contest at the University of Maryland, College Park on 13–17 June 2027. International schools in China, Korea and elsewhere take part through NHD International.

en: Five formats: paper, exhibit, film, performance, website
2027 theme: Innovation in History
National Contest at University of Maryland

eligibility.en: Students in grades 6–12 (junior and senior divisions) in US states/territories, Department of Defense schools and NHD International affiliates.

en: Pick a topic linked to the 2027 theme
Research using primary sources and build your entry
Register for your local or affiliate contest (dates vary)
Advance to the National Contest in June

costs.en: Affiliate and national registration fees vary; travel to nationals is self-funded.

score_reason: Respected history research contest; US and international affiliates

org: Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC), University of Waterloo

name.en: Fryer, Galois and Hypatia Mathematics Contests 2027
name.ka: Fryer, Galois და Hypatia მათემატიკური კონკურსები 2027

deadline_note: Ordering deadline 11 Mar 2027 (schools order); contest 7 Apr 2027 (Americas) / 8 Apr 2027 (elsewhere)

summary.en: Three written-solution maths contests from the University of Waterloo for grades 9 (Fryer), 10 (Galois) and 11 (Hypatia), sat in schools worldwide on 7–8 April 2027. Schools order by 11 March 2027.
summary.ka: ვატერლოოს უნივერსიტეტის სამი მათემატიკური კონკურსი სრული ამოხსნებით: მე-9 (Fryer), მე-10 (Galois) და მე-11 (Hypatia) კლასებისთვის, რომლებიც მსოფლიოს სკოლებში 2027 წლის 7–8 აპრილს ტარდება. სკოლები შეკვეთას 2027 წლის 11 მარტამდე აკეთებენ.
summary.ar: ثلاث مسابقات رياضيات بحلول مكتوبة من جامعة واترلو للصفوف التاسع (Fryer) والعاشر (Galois) والحادي عشر (Hypatia)، تُعقد في مدارس حول العالم في 7–8 أبريل 2027. وتطلب المدارس الاختبارات حتى 11 مارس 2027.

about.en:
The CEMC contests are among the most widely written maths competitions in the world. Fryer, Galois and Hypatia are 75-minute papers with four multi-part questions requiring full written solutions, which develops proof-style communication.

Schools anywhere can order the contests (paper or online). Top students receive certificates and medals and are recognised in published results; strong performance is noticed by Waterloo's Faculty of Mathematics admissions.

en: Full written solutions, not multiple choice
Sat in schools worldwide
Recognised by University of Waterloo

eligibility.en: Grade 9 (Fryer), 10 (Galois), 11 (Hypatia) students, or younger students writing up; one contest per student per year. Schools worldwide may participate.

en: Ask your maths teacher to order the contest from CEMC by 11 March 2027
Practise with past contests on the CEMC site
Write the contest at school on 7 or 8 April 2027

costs.en: CAD 12 per participant plus processing and shipping fees (paid by the school).

score_reason: Widely recognised, school-based, open worldwide

org: Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC), University of Waterloo
deadline_note: Ordering deadline 22 Apr 2027; contest window 10–21 May 2027

summary.en: The University of Waterloo's maths contest for grades 7 and 8, written in schools worldwide between 10 and 21 May 2027. Schools order contests by 22 April 2027.
summary.ka: ვატერლოოს უნივერსიტეტის მათემატიკური კონკურსი მე-7 და მე-8 კლასებისთვის, რომელიც მსოფლიოს სკოლებში 2027 წლის 10–21 მაისს იწერება. სკოლები შეკვეთას 2027 წლის 22 აპრილამდე აკეთებენ.
summary.ar: مسابقة الرياضيات من جامعة واترلو لطلاب الصفين السابع والثامن، تُكتب في المدارس حول العالم بين 10 و21 مايو 2027. وتطلب المدارس الاختبارات حتى 22 أبريل 2027.

about.en:
Gauss is a 60-minute, 25-question multiple-choice contest designed to build problem-solving skills in middle school. It is one of the most popular CEMC contests, written by students in dozens of countries.

Schools order contests online and run them in class during the window; certificates go to top students and schools.

en: Ideal first maths competition
Written in school, paper or online
Worldwide participation

eligibility.en: Students in grades 7 and 8 (younger students welcome); schools anywhere.

en: Ask your teacher to order Gauss from CEMC by 22 April 2027
Practise with past papers
Write the contest in school between 10 and 21 May 2027

costs.en: CAD 5 per participant (minimum 10) plus processing and shipping fees, paid by the school.

score_reason: Good entry-level contest, school-based

org: Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC), University of Waterloo
deadline_note: Lottery registration for the UWaterloo event closes 19 Nov 2026; in-school event ordering by 12 Apr 2027

summary.en: A team maths contest for six-student secondary-school teams, held at the University of Waterloo (in person or virtually) on 13 April 2027 or in schools from 14 April. The lottery for Waterloo places closes on 19 November 2026.
summary.ka: გუნდური მათემატიკური კონკურსი ექვსკაციანი სასკოლო გუნდებისთვის, რომელიც ვატერლოოს უნივერსიტეტში (პირისპირ ან ვირტუალურად) 2027 წლის 13 აპრილს ან სკოლებში 14 აპრილიდან ტარდება. ვატერლოოში ადგილების ლატარიის რეგისტრაცია 2026 წლის 19 ნოემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: مسابقة رياضيات لفرق من ستة طلاب من المرحلة الثانوية، تُقام في جامعة واترلو (حضوريًا أو افتراضيًا) في 13 أبريل 2027 أو في المدارس ابتداءً من 14 أبريل. ويُغلق تسجيل القرعة لمقاعد واترلو في 19 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The CTMC combines individual, team and relay rounds in a fun, fast-paced day of mathematics. Teams of six students from grades 9–12 compete; schools can enter one team in the Waterloo-hosted event (by lottery) or run unlimited teams in school.

The Waterloo event includes a campus experience; virtual participation is also possible.

en: Team, individual and relay rounds
Waterloo campus event or in-school
Any mix of grades 9–12

eligibility.en: Teams of six secondary-school students (grades 9–12) with one educator; in-school option open to schools in all regions.

en: Teacher enters the UWaterloo lottery by 19 Nov 2026, or orders the in-school event by 12 Apr 2027
Form a team of six
Compete on 13 April (Waterloo) or from 14 April (in school)

costs.en: CAD 240 per team in person / CAD 60 virtual at UWaterloo; in-school CAD 50 for unlimited teams plus processing.

score_reason: Team format; lottery deadline soon

duration.ar: موسم من عدة جولات على مدى أشهر

deadline_note: Registration open for 2026–27 (see Critical Dates page); chapter Feb 2027, state Mar 2027, national 9–10 May 2027

summary.en: The leading US middle-school maths competition, from school rounds through chapter (February) and state (March) contests to the national final on 9–10 May 2027. School registration for 2026–27 is open.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის წამყვანი მათემატიკური შეჯიბრი საშუალო საფეხურის მოსწავლეებისთვის: სასკოლო ტურებიდან რაიონულ (თებერვალი) და შტატის (მარტი) შეჯიბრებამდე და ეროვნულ ფინალამდე 2027 წლის 9–10 მაისს. 2026–27 წლის სასკოლო რეგისტრაცია ღიაა.
summary.ar: أبرز مسابقة رياضيات للمرحلة المتوسطة في الولايات المتحدة، من الجولات المدرسية إلى مسابقات المناطق (فبراير) والولايات (مارس) وصولًا إلى النهائي الوطني في 9–10 مايو 2027. والتسجيل المدرسي لموسم 2026–27 مفتوح.

about.en:
MATHCOUNTS runs written and oral rounds (Sprint, Target, Team and the Countdown Round) for students in grades 6–8. Schools register, practise and run a school competition from November, then send up to 14 competitors to chapter contests in February 2027; winners advance to state contests in March and the RTX MATHCOUNTS National Competition on 9–10 May 2027.

It is the classic US pathway to later olympiad success (AMC, USAMO).

en: Grades 6–8 pathway to nationals
Individual and team rounds
National Competition 9–10 May 2027

eligibility.en: Students in grades 6–8 at US schools (all 50 states and territories, plus US-affiliated schools per MATHCOUNTS rules).

en: Ask a teacher/coach to register your school
Practise with MATHCOUNTS materials
Compete at your school, then chapter (Feb) and state (Mar)

costs.en: School registration fee (see MATHCOUNTS); no extra fees to advance to state.

score_reason: Top US middle-school maths pathway

name.ar: الأولمبياد الأمريكي لعلم الفلك والفيزياء الفلكية (USAAAO) 2027

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2026 cycle (registration 1–31 Jan, first round 9 Feb, proctored at school); confirm 2027 dates

summary.en: The selection olympiad for the US team at the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics, starting with a proctored first-round exam in February. Registration usually runs through January.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის გუნდის შესარჩევი ოლიმპიადა ასტრონომიისა და ასტროფიზიკის საერთაშორისო ოლიმპიადისთვის, რომელიც თებერვალში სკოლაში ზედამხედველობით ჩატარებული პირველი ტურით იწყება. რეგისტრაცია ჩვეულებრივ იანვარში მიმდინარეობს.
summary.ar: أولمبياد اختيار الفريق الأمريكي للأولمبياد الدولي لعلم الفلك والفيزياء الفلكية، ويبدأ باختبار جولة أولى تحت إشراف المدرسة في فبراير. ويجري التسجيل عادة طوال يناير.

about.en:
USAAAO's first round is a proctored exam at the student's school covering astronomy and astrophysics. High scorers progress to a second round and a training camp that selects the US team for the IOAA.

Any student can sit the exam (so international students at participating schools can test themselves), but only US citizens or permanent residents can represent the US. A financial aid form is available for the fee.

en: First round proctored at school
Path to the IOAA
Fee waivers available

eligibility.en: High-school students; anyone may take the exam, but only US citizens/permanent residents can join the US team. A teacher must proctor in person.

en: Find a teacher willing to proctor
Register during the January window on usaaao.org
Take the first-round exam in February
Qualify for round two and camp

costs.en: About USD 30 per student in 2026 (USD 20 for schools with 5+ students); aid available.

score_reason: Niche olympiad; registration in January

org: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

name.en: FAO World Food Day Poster Contest 2026
name.ka: FAO-ს მსოფლიო სურსათის დღის პოსტერების კონკურსი 2026
name.ar: مسابقة ملصقات يوم الأغذية العالمي 2026 من منظمة الفاو

duration.ar: تقديم عمل واحد، والنتائج بعد أشهر

deadline_note: Entries close 6 Nov 2026, 12:00 CET (official contest page)

summary.en: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's annual poster contest for young people aged 5–19 worldwide, on the World Food Day theme. Digital entries close at noon CET on 6 November 2026.
summary.ka: გაეროს სურსათისა და სოფლის მეურნეობის ორგანიზაციის ყოველწლიური პოსტერების კონკურსი მთელი მსოფლიოს 5–19 წლის ახალგაზრდებისთვის, მსოფლიო სურსათის დღის თემაზე. ციფრული ნამუშევრების მიღება 2026 წლის 6 ნოემბერს, CET-ით შუადღისას სრულდება.
summary.ar: مسابقة الملصقات السنوية لمنظمة الأغذية والزراعة التابعة للأمم المتحدة للشباب من سن 5 إلى 19 عامًا حول العالم، حول موضوع يوم الأغذية العالمي. ويُغلق باب استقبال الأعمال الرقمية ظهر 6 نوفمبر 2026 بتوقيت وسط أوروبا.

about.en:
Every year FAO invites children and teenagers to create a poster on the World Food Day theme, raising awareness of hunger, nutrition and sustainable food systems. There are four age categories: 5–8, 9–12, 13–15 and 16–19.

Entries are submitted as a digital JPEG through the online form (one entry per person; generative AI images are not allowed, though AI-assisted ideation or editing must be disclosed). Fifteen posters per category are shortlisted in December 2026, and three winners per category are showcased on FAO's World Food Day website and social media, with certificates and gift bags.

en: Run by a UN agency
Free, open worldwide, ages 5–19
Winners promoted by FAO globally

eligibility.en: Anyone aged 5–19 anywhere in the world (minors need parental permission); one entry per person; FAO staff families excluded.

en: Read the World Food Day 2026 theme and rules
Create your poster (drawing, painting, digital art) — up to 25 words of text
Photograph or scan it as a JPEG
Submit via the online form before 6 Nov 2026, 12:00 CET

costs.en: Free to enter.

score_reason: UN contest, free, global, closes in a week

name.ar: مسابقة Jugend Innovativ 2026/27 للابتكار الشبابي في النمسا

deadline_note: 'Einreichdeadline: 30. Nov. 2026' on the official homepage; national final in spring 2027

summary.en: Austria's national school competition for innovative projects in design, engineering, entrepreneurship, ICT, science and sustainability, for students and apprentices aged 15–20. Project ideas must be submitted by 30 November 2026.
summary.ka: ავსტრიის ეროვნული სასკოლო კონკურსი ინოვაციური პროექტებისთვის დიზაინში, ინჟინერიაში, მეწარმეობაში, ICT-ში, მეცნიერებასა და მდგრადობაში, 15–20 წლის მოსწავლეებისა და შეგირდებისთვის. პროექტის იდეები 2026 წლის 30 ნოემბრამდე უნდა წარადგინონ.
summary.ar: المسابقة المدرسية الوطنية في النمسا للمشاريع المبتكرة في التصميم والهندسة وريادة الأعمال وتقنية المعلومات والعلوم والاستدامة، للطلاب والمتدربين من سن 15 إلى 20 عامًا. ويجب تقديم أفكار المشاريع بحلول 30 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Jugend Innovativ, run by the federal promotional bank aws for the Austrian ministries, is the country's main youth innovation contest and Austria's route to international events such as EUCYS and ISEF. Students submit a project idea in one of six categories (Design & Creation, Engineering, Entrepreneurship, ICT & Digital, Science, Sustainability), develop it over the school year with coaching, and the best teams present at the national final.

Winners receive cash prizes and bonuses and can be nominated for international competitions and events.

en: Six categories from design to science
Cash prizes and international nominations
Coaching during the school year

eligibility.en: Pupils, apprentices and people in their first year of vocational training aged 15–20, at schools/companies in Austria; individuals or teams. Projects in German.

en: Pick a category and form a team (or enter alone)
Submit your project idea online by 30 November 2026
Develop the project with your teacher during the year
Present at the regional/national final if selected

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: National innovation contest with EUCYS/ISEF pathway; Austria only

summary.en: Atlassian's global online hackathon: build an app on the Forge platform that extends Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket or Rovo, competing for about $120,000 in prizes. Submissions close on 22 December 2026.
summary.ka: Atlassian-ის გლობალური ონლაინ ჰაკათონი: შექმენი აპლიკაცია Forge პლატფორმაზე, რომელიც Jira-ს, Confluence-ს, Bitbucket-ს ან Rovo-ს აფართოებს, და იბრძოლე დაახლოებით 120,000 დოლარის პრიზებისთვის. ნამუშევრების მიღება 2026 წლის 22 დეკემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: هاكاثون Atlassian العالمي عبر الإنترنت: ابنِ تطبيقًا على منصة Forge يوسّع Jira أو Confluence أو Bitbucket أو Rovo، وتنافس على جوائز تقارب 120,000 دولار. ويُغلق باب التقديم في 22 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Codegeist is Atlassian's annual developer hackathon. Entrants build a new app (or rebuild an existing one) on Atlassian Forge that integrates with at least one Atlassian product or capability, then submit a demo video, description and code on the hackathon site.

Judging runs 5 January–3 February 2027 and winners are announced around 15 February 2027. It is fully online, so university students anywhere (subject to the rules' country exclusions) can take part and build a portfolio project around widely used developer tools.

en: ~$120,000 prize pool
Fully online, individuals or teams
Build on Atlassian Forge (Jira, Confluence, Rovo)

eligibility.en: Individuals who are at least the age of majority where they live (usually 18+), teams of eligible individuals, and organisations. Standard Devpost exclusions apply (residents of US-embargoed countries/regions and certain other jurisdictions; sponsor employees). Check the official rules before entering.

en: Register on codegeist2026.devpost.com
Set up a free Atlassian developer account and Forge CLI
Build and test your Forge app
Submit video, description and repo before 22 Dec 2026, 12:00 pm PT

costs.en: Free to enter.

score_reason: Corporate online hackathon, big prizes, 18+ only

org: Amazon Web Services — Kiro (administered by Devpost)

name.ar: هاكاثون Kiroween 2026 من AWS عبر الإنترنت

duration.ar: موسم من عدة جولات على مدى أشهر

deadline_note: Submission period 30 Oct–4 Dec 2026, 2:00 pm PT; no extensions (official rules)

summary.en: A beginner-friendly online hackathon from Amazon Web Services where teams of up to three build projects with the Kiro AI coding tool, competing for about $100,000 in prizes. Submissions close on 4 December 2026.
summary.ka: Amazon Web Services-ის დამწყებთათვის შესაფერისი ონლაინ ჰაკათონი, სადაც სამკაციანი გუნდები Kiro-ს, ხელოვნური ინტელექტის კოდირების ხელსაწყოს, გამოყენებით ქმნიან პროექტებს და დაახლოებით 100,000 დოლარის პრიზებისთვის იბრძვიან. ნამუშევრების მიღება 2026 წლის 4 დეკემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: هاكاثون عبر الإنترنت مناسب للمبتدئين من Amazon Web Services، تبني فيه فرق من ثلاثة أعضاء كحد أقصى مشاريع باستخدام أداة البرمجة بالذكاء الاصطناعي Kiro، وتتنافس على جوائز تقارب 100,000 دولار. ويُغلق باب التقديم في 4 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Kiroween is a Halloween-themed hackathon sponsored by AWS to showcase Kiro, its agentic AI development environment. Entrants build an open-ended project using Kiro, submit a demo video and repository, and can request a one-time allotment of Kiro credits.

Judging runs from 16 December 2026 to 29 January 2027, with winners announced around 3 February 2027. Bonus prizes reward social posts and blog write-ups about the build.

en: ~$100,000 prize pool
Free Kiro credits on request
Teams of up to 3, fully online

eligibility.en: Individuals who are at least the age of majority where they live (usually 18+), teams of eligible individuals, and organisations. Standard Devpost exclusions apply (residents of US-embargoed countries/regions and certain other jurisdictions; sponsor employees). Check the official rules before entering.

en: Register on kiroween.devpost.com
Install Kiro and request credits via the form
Build your project with Kiro
Submit before 4 Dec 2026, 2:00 pm PT

costs.en: Free to enter.

score_reason: Big-prize online AI hackathon; adults only

duration.ar: موسم من عدة جولات على مدى أشهر

deadline_note: Submission period 1 Oct–12 Nov 2026, 12:00 pm PT (official rules)

summary.en: An online hackathon from PayPal: build an app that combines the PayPal developer platform (free sandbox) with an AI tool or model, competing for $67,500 in prizes. Submissions close on 12 November 2026.
summary.ka: PayPal-ის ონლაინ ჰაკათონი: შექმენი აპლიკაცია, რომელიც PayPal-ის დეველოპერულ პლატფორმას (უფასო sandbox) ხელოვნური ინტელექტის ხელსაწყოსთან ან მოდელთან აერთიანებს, და იბრძოლე 67,500 დოლარის პრიზებისთვის. ნამუშევრების მიღება 2026 წლის 12 ნოემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: هاكاثون عبر الإنترنت من PayPal: ابنِ تطبيقًا يجمع بين منصة PayPal للمطورين (بيئة تجريبية مجانية) وأداة أو نموذج ذكاء اصطناعي، وتنافس على جوائز قدرها 67,500 دولار. ويُغلق باب التقديم في 12 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Entrants build or significantly update an application that integrates PayPal's developer APIs (in the free sandbox) with any AI tool, model or platform, then submit a demo video and project description.

Judging runs 1–15 December 2026 and winners are announced around 21 December 2026. Over 20,000 people have registered, making it one of the largest open fintech hackathons of the season.

en: $67,500 in prizes
Fintech + AI theme
Free sandbox, fully online

eligibility.en: Individuals who are at least the age of majority where they live (usually 18+), teams of eligible individuals, and organisations. Standard Devpost exclusions apply (residents of US-embargoed countries/regions and certain other jurisdictions; sponsor employees). Check the official rules before entering.

en: Register on paypalaihackathon.devpost.com
Create a free PayPal developer account
Build your AI + PayPal app
Submit before 12 Nov 2026, 12:00 pm PT

costs.en: Free to enter.

score_reason: Large online fintech/AI hackathon; adults only

org: ICPC Foundation with Huawei (hosted on Codeforces)

name.en: ICPC 2026 Online Challenge 2, powered by Huawei
name.ar: تحدي ICPC 2026 الثاني عبر الإنترنت بدعم من Huawei

deadline_note: Starts 5 Nov 2026, 11:00 UTC and runs 14 days (Codeforces official contest list)

summary.en: A two-week online optimisation challenge organised by ICPC with Huawei on Codeforces, where participants tackle a hard real-world style problem with approximate algorithms. It starts on 5 November 2026.
summary.ka: ორკვირიანი ონლაინ ოპტიმიზაციის გამოწვევა, რომელსაც ICPC Huawei-სთან ერთად Codeforces-ზე ატარებს; მონაწილეები რთულ, რეალურ ამოცანას მიახლოებითი ალგორითმებით ხსნიან. იწყება 2026 წლის 5 ნოემბერს.
summary.ar: تحدٍّ للتحسين عبر الإنترنت لمدة أسبوعين تنظمه ICPC مع Huawei على Codeforces، يعالج فيه المشاركون مسألة صعبة شبيهة بمسائل الواقع باستخدام خوارزميات تقريبية. ويبدأ في 5 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The ICPC Online Challenge is a heuristic ('marathon') contest: instead of exact answers, participants submit programs whose scores improve as their solutions get better, over a two-week window. Previous editions have been powered by Huawei with problems from its research labs, and top performers win prizes and recognition from ICPC.

It is open to registered Codeforces users, making it an accessible way for university and advanced high-school programmers to gain ICPC-branded results.

en: Two-week heuristic optimisation contest
Organised by ICPC with Huawei
Free, online, open to Codeforces users

eligibility.en: Anyone with a Codeforces account can take part; prize eligibility is set in the contest announcement (check age/country rules).

en: Create a Codeforces account
Register for the contest on the Codeforces contests page
Read the problem when it opens on 5 Nov 2026
Submit improving solutions until the window closes

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free ICPC-branded online contest starting soon

deadline_note: Contest 27 Nov 2026, 14:35 UTC (150 min); practice round from 20 Nov (Codeforces official contest list)

summary.en: A Codeforces round co-organised with JetBrains in which every solution must be written in Kotlin, with prizes for top finishers. Episode 15 takes place on 27 November 2026, with a week-long practice round from 20 November.
summary.ka: Codeforces-ის რაუნდი, რომელსაც JetBrains-თან ერთად ატარებენ და სადაც ყველა ამოხსნა Kotlin-ზე უნდა დაიწეროს, საუკეთესოებისთვის პრიზებით. მე-15 ეპიზოდი 2026 წლის 27 ნოემბერს ჩატარდება, 20 ნოემბრიდან კი ერთკვირიანი სავარჯიშო რაუნდია.
summary.ar: جولة على Codeforces تُنظَّم بالتعاون مع JetBrains ويجب فيها كتابة كل الحلول بلغة Kotlin، مع جوائز للمتصدرين. وتُقام الحلقة 15 في 27 نوفمبر 2026، مع جولة تدريبية لمدة أسبوع تبدأ في 20 نوفمبر.

about.en:
Kotlin Heroes rounds are 2.5-hour algorithmic contests run on Codeforces with JetBrains, the creator of Kotlin. They introduce competitive programmers to Kotlin and reward top finishers with prizes such as cash and branded merchandise (see the round announcement).

A practice round opens a week earlier so newcomers can learn Kotlin syntax before the main event.

en: Free online contest by JetBrains
Practice round from 20 Nov
Prizes for top finishers

eligibility.en: Anyone with a Codeforces account; prize rules in the official announcement.

en: Create a Codeforces account
Try the practice round (from 20 Nov)
Register for Episode 15 and compete on 27 Nov 2026, 14:35 UTC

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Fun, free, niche programming round

org: European Space Agency & Raspberry Pi Foundation

name.ka: Astro Pi Mission Zero 2026/27 (ESA-ს კოსმოსური პროგრამირების მისია)
name.ar: مهمة Astro Pi Mission Zero 2026/27 من وكالة الفضاء الأوروبية

deadline_note: Entries open 14 Sep 2026–22 Mar 2027, 12:00 noon CET (official page)

summary.en: A free one-hour beginner coding mission from ESA: young people write a short Python program that runs on a Raspberry Pi aboard the International Space Station. Entries close on 22 March 2027.
summary.ka: ESA-ს უფასო, ერთსაათიანი დამწყებთა პროგრამირების მისია: ახალგაზრდები წერენ მოკლე Python პროგრამას, რომელიც საერთაშორისო კოსმოსურ სადგურზე Raspberry Pi კომპიუტერზე ეშვება. ნამუშევრების მიღება 2027 წლის 22 მარტს სრულდება.
summary.ar: مهمة برمجة مجانية للمبتدئين مدتها ساعة واحدة من وكالة الفضاء الأوروبية: يكتب الشباب برنامج Python قصيرًا يعمل على حاسوب Raspberry Pi على متن محطة الفضاء الدولية. ويُغلق باب المشاركة في 22 مارس 2027.

about.en:
In Mission Zero, participants (alone or in teams of up to four) write a program that reads a sensor on the Astro Pi computer on the ISS and uses it to set the background colour of a pixel image for the astronauts. It takes about an hour, needs no prior coding experience, and every valid program runs in space; participants receive a certificate showing where the ISS was when their code ran.

A mentor (teacher, parent, club leader) registers and gets a classroom code. Eligibility is limited to ESA member states and partner countries.

en: Your code runs on the ISS
One hour, beginner friendly
Certificate for every valid entry

eligibility.en: Age 19 or under, supervised by a mentor, enrolled in a school or club in an ESA Member State (Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK) or Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Slovakia; at least 50% of each team must be nationals of these countries.

en: A mentor registers on astro-pi.org and gets a classroom code
Follow the step-by-step Mission Zero guide
Write and test your Python program in the online emulator
Submit before 22 March 2027, 12:00 CET

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free ESA coding mission; Europe/Canada only

org: European Space Agency & Raspberry Pi Foundation

name.ka: Astro Pi Mission Space Lab 2026/27 (ESA-ს კოსმოსური ლაბორატორია)
name.ar: مهمة Astro Pi Mission Space Lab 2026/27 من وكالة الفضاء الأوروبية

deadline_note: Registration 14 Sep 2026–22 Feb 2027, 12:00 CET (official page)

summary.en: ESA's team challenge in which young people write a Python program that collects sensor data from Raspberry Pi computers on the International Space Station for a real science task. Team registration closes on 22 February 2027.
summary.ka: ESA-ს გუნდური გამოწვევა, სადაც ახალგაზრდები წერენ Python პროგრამას, რომელიც საერთაშორისო კოსმოსურ სადგურზე Raspberry Pi კომპიუტერების სენსორებიდან რეალური სამეცნიერო ამოცანისთვის მონაცემებს აგროვებს. გუნდების რეგისტრაცია 2027 წლის 22 თებერვალს სრულდება.
summary.ar: تحدٍّ جماعي من وكالة الفضاء الأوروبية يكتب فيه الشباب برنامج Python يجمع بيانات أجهزة الاستشعار من حواسيب Raspberry Pi على محطة الفضاء الدولية لمهمة علمية حقيقية. ويُغلق تسجيل الفرق في 22 فبراير 2027.

about.en:
Mission Space Lab teams of 2–6 young people, supervised by a mentor, write and test a Python program that uses the Astro Pi's camera and sensors on the ISS to complete a scientific task set by ESA (recent editions asked teams to calculate the speed of the ISS). Programs that pass testing are run in orbit and teams receive their data and a certificate.

It is a genuine taste of space-mission software engineering and an excellent project for applications in engineering and physics.

en: Teams of 2–6 with a mentor
Programs run on the ISS
Real ESA-set science task

eligibility.en: Age 19 or under, in teams of 2–6 with a mentor, at schools/clubs in ESA Member States or Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Slovakia; at least 50% of team members nationals of these countries.

en: A mentor registers the team on astro-pi.org by 22 Feb 2027
Follow the project guide and write the program
Test with the Astro Pi emulator
Mentor submits the program before the deadline

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free ESA team challenge; Europe/Canada only

deadline_note: School registration 16 Sep 2026–11 Jan 2027; round one written test 21 Jan 2027 (official page)

summary.en: The Royal Society of Chemistry's national olympiad for students aged 16–19 in the British Isles, the first step towards the UK team at the International Chemistry Olympiad. Schools register by 11 January and round one is sat on 21 January 2027.
summary.ka: სამეფო ქიმიური საზოგადოების ეროვნული ოლიმპიადა ბრიტანეთის კუნძულების 16–19 წლის მოსწავლეებისთვის — პირველი ნაბიჯი ქიმიის საერთაშორისო ოლიმპიადაზე გაერთიანებული სამეფოს გუნდისკენ. სკოლები რეგისტრირდებიან 11 იანვრამდე, პირველი ტური კი 2027 წლის 21 იანვარს ტარდება.
summary.ar: الأولمبياد الوطني للجمعية الملكية للكيمياء للطلاب من سن 16 إلى 19 في الجزر البريطانية، وهو الخطوة الأولى نحو فريق المملكة المتحدة في الأولمبياد الدولي للكيمياء. تسجّل المدارس حتى 11 يناير وتُعقد الجولة الأولى في 21 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Round one is a two-hour written paper of real-world chemistry problems taken in school on 21 January 2027 and marked by teachers. High scorers are invited to round two and a selection camp that picks the four students representing the UK at the IChO.

Schools register through a free Teach Chemistry account. Certificates go to all participants aged 19 and under. British international schools overseas may apply to take part after reading the eligibility FAQ.

en: Free, run by the Royal Society of Chemistry
Round one sat in school on 21 Jan 2027
Pathway to the IChO

eligibility.en: Students (recommended 16+) at secondary schools and colleges in the British Isles; British international schools overseas may apply by email after checking the FAQ.

en: Ask your chemistry teacher to register the school (Teach Chemistry account) by 11 Jan 2027
Practise with past papers and worked answers
Sit round one on 21 January 2027

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free national olympiad; UK/Ireland schools

deadline_note: Round 1 (Breakthrough/Foundation/Intermediate) papers released 7 Jan 2027, test week 11–16 Jan 2027; Round 2 on 3 Feb 2027 (official 2026-7 calendar). The Advanced round-1 entry closed 2 Nov 2026.

summary.en: The UK's linguistics olympiad, where school students solve puzzles about real languages they have never studied. Round 1 for the Breakthrough, Foundation and Intermediate levels runs on 11–16 January 2027.
summary.ka: გაერთიანებული სამეფოს ლინგვისტიკის ოლიმპიადა, სადაც მოსწავლეები ხსნიან თავსატეხებს რეალურ ენებზე, რომლებიც არასოდეს უსწავლიათ. Breakthrough, Foundation და Intermediate დონეების პირველი ტური 2027 წლის 11–16 იანვარს ტარდება.
summary.ar: أولمبياد اللسانيات في المملكة المتحدة، يحل فيه الطلاب ألغازًا عن لغات حقيقية لم يدرسوها من قبل. وتُعقد الجولة الأولى لمستويات Breakthrough وFoundation وIntermediate من 11 إلى 16 يناير 2027.

about.en:
UKLO problems give a few sentences in an unfamiliar language (from Ancient Greek to Yoruba to sign languages) and ask students to deduce the grammar and translate new sentences — pure logic, no prior knowledge needed. Levels range from Breakthrough (primary) to Advanced.

Schools register on the UKLO portal and run the round-1 test in their own week; top Advanced/Intermediate scorers are invited to Round 2 (3 February 2027) and training that selects the UK team for the International Linguistics Olympiad.

en: No language knowledge needed — pure reasoning
Levels from primary to sixth form
Pathway to the IOL

eligibility.en: Students at UK schools (and some overseas schools via the portal) entered by a registered teacher; level depends on age.

en: Ask a teacher to register on the UKLO portal
Try past puzzles on uklo.org
Sit Round 1 in school during 11–16 Jan 2027
Qualify for Round 2 on 3 Feb 2027

costs.en: Small per-student or per-school fee (see UKLO).

score_reason: Accessible logic contest with IOL pathway

deadline_note: Registration opens 19 Feb 2027 and closes 24 Feb 2027; Round 1 on 17 Mar 2027, Round 2 on 29 Mar 2027 (official site)

summary.en: A team linguistics olympiad for secondary-school students (years 7–12) in Australia, solving puzzles about real languages in teams of four. Registration opens on 19 February 2027 and Round 1 is on 17 March 2027.
summary.ka: გუნდური ლინგვისტიკის ოლიმპიადა ავსტრალიის საშუალო სკოლის მოსწავლეებისთვის (7–12 კლასები), სადაც ოთხკაციანი გუნდები რეალური ენების თავსატეხებს ხსნიან. რეგისტრაცია 2027 წლის 19 თებერვალს იხსნება, პირველი ტური კი 17 მარტს ტარდება.
summary.ar: أولمبياد لسانيات جماعي لطلاب المرحلة الثانوية (الصفوف 7–12) في أستراليا، تحل فيه فرق من أربعة طلاب ألغازًا عن لغات حقيقية. يُفتح التسجيل في 19 فبراير 2027 وتُعقد الجولة الأولى في 17 مارس 2027.

about.en:
OzCLO is a volunteer-run contest in which teams of four develop their own strategies to decode problems about real languages and computational linguistics. Round 1 is held online on 17 March 2027; the best teams go to Round 2 on 29 March, which leads to the Asia Pacific Linguistics Olympiad (APLO) and selection for the International Linguistics Olympiad 2027 in Bangkok.

Teachers register teams through an OzCLO teacher account during the short February window.

en: Teams of four
Leads to APLO and IOL 2027
Run by volunteers, school-based

eligibility.en: Secondary-school students in years 7–12 at Australian schools, in teams of four registered by a teacher.

en: Teacher creates an OzCLO account
Register teams between 19 and 24 Feb 2027
Practise with past problems
Compete in Round 1 on 17 Mar 2027

costs.en: Check the OzCLO site for any registration fee.

score_reason: Team linguistics olympiad; Australian schools

deadline_note: Challenge runs 9–20 Nov 2026 in schools (official homepage)

summary.en: The UK edition of the international Bebras challenge: a free 40-minute online test of computational thinking puzzles, sat in school between 9 and 20 November 2026.
summary.ka: საერთაშორისო Bebras გამოწვევის ბრიტანული ვერსია: უფასო, 40-წუთიანი ონლაინ ტესტი კომპიუტერული აზროვნების თავსატეხებით, რომელიც სკოლაში 2026 წლის 9–20 ნოემბერს იწერება.
summary.ar: النسخة البريطانية من تحدي Bebras الدولي: اختبار مجاني عبر الإنترنت مدته 40 دقيقة لألغاز التفكير الحاسوبي، يُؤدّى في المدرسة بين 9 و20 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Bebras runs every November in over 60 countries. Its puzzles teach the ideas behind computing (algorithms, logic, data structures) without needing any programming. The UK challenge, now run by the Raspberry Pi Foundation, has age categories from Kits (6–8) up to Elite (16–18).

Teachers register their school and run the challenge in class during the two-week window; top performers in older groups are invited to the Oxford University Computing Challenge (OUCC).

en: Free, no coding needed
Age categories 6–18
Top scorers invited to the Oxford Computing Challenge

eligibility.en: Pupils at UK schools (and some British schools abroad via the teacher portal), aged roughly 6–18; entered by a registered teacher.

en: Ask a teacher to register the school at bebras.uk
Practise with past Bebras puzzles
Sit the 40-minute challenge in school between 9 and 20 November 2026

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free, accessible; window opens next week

grades: ages up to 30 (students/youth clubs); Junior for under-18
deadline_note: National qualifiers in spring 2027 (e.g. Eurobot Belgium 17–18 Apr 2027); international finals 5–8 May 2027 (official site). Register via your National Organising Committee.

summary.en: An international autonomous-robotics contest for student and youth teams, with national qualifiers in spring and international finals on 5–8 May 2027. Eurobot Junior runs in parallel for younger teams with remote-controlled robots.
summary.ka: საერთაშორისო ავტონომიური რობოტიკის კონკურსი სტუდენტური და ახალგაზრდული გუნდებისთვის, გაზაფხულზე ეროვნული შესარჩევებით და 2027 წლის 5–8 მაისს საერთაშორისო ფინალით. Eurobot Junior უმცროსი გუნდებისთვის დისტანციურად მართული რობოტებით პარალელურად ტარდება.
summary.ar: مسابقة دولية للروبوتات الذاتية لفرق الطلاب والشباب، مع تصفيات وطنية في الربيع ونهائيات دولية من 5 إلى 8 مايو 2027. وتُقام Eurobot Junior بالتوازي للفرق الأصغر سنًا بروبوتات يُتحكم بها عن بُعد.

about.en:
Created in 1998, Eurobot challenges teams to design and build autonomous robots that complete a set of tasks on a themed table within 100 seconds; the 2027 season's rules were published in October 2026. Teams first compete in their national cup run by a National Organising Committee; the best qualify for the international finals.

The event is held in Europe but welcomes teams from all continents. Countries without a national committee can contact Eurobot about direct participation.

en: Autonomous robots, new theme each year
National cups then international finals (5–8 May 2027)
Junior version for school teams

eligibility.en: Student and youth teams (university clubs, schools, maker clubs) through their country's Eurobot National Organising Committee; Eurobot Junior for younger students.

en: Read the 2027 rules on eurobot.org
Contact your National Organising Committee to register
Build and test your robot over the season
Compete at the national cup to qualify for the finals

costs.en: Team registration fees set by national committees; robot materials and travel are self-funded.

score_reason: Respected robotics league; register nationally

deadline_note: International Challenge 5–6 Jun 2027 (official homepage); teams qualify through regional SeaPerch events during the season

summary.en: An underwater-robotics competition in which school teams build a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) from a kit and compete in obstacle and mission courses. The 2027 International Challenge is on 5–6 June 2027.
summary.ka: წყალქვეშა რობოტიკის შეჯიბრი, სადაც სასკოლო გუნდები ნაკრებიდან აწყობენ დისტანციურად მართულ აპარატს (ROV) და დაბრკოლებებისა და მისიების ტრასებზე ეჯიბრებიან. 2027 წლის საერთაშორისო გამოწვევა 5–6 ივნისს ტარდება.
summary.ar: مسابقة روبوتات تحت الماء تبني فيها فرق مدرسية مركبة يتم التحكم فيها عن بُعد (ROV) من مجموعة قطع وتتنافس في مسارات العوائق والمهام. ويُقام التحدي الدولي لعام 2027 في 5–6 يونيو 2027.

about.en:
SeaPerch, run by the nonprofit RoboNation, introduces students to marine engineering: teams build a SeaPerch ROV, then test it in pool-based obstacle and mission courses and present an engineering notebook. Regional competitions across the US and in several other countries feed into the International Challenge.

Kits are low-cost and the programme provides curriculum for teachers, making it an accessible first robotics competition.

en: Build an underwater ROV from a kit
Regional events feed the international final
Low-cost entry robotics

eligibility.en: Middle- and high-school teams registered through a SeaPerch regional competition (mostly US; some international regionals).

en: Get a SeaPerch kit and register on seaperch.org
Build and test your ROV
Compete at a regional SeaPerch event
Qualify for the International Challenge in June 2027

costs.en: Kit and registration costs (see seaperch.org); travel self-funded.

score_reason: Accessible robotics, mostly US

name.ar: مسابقة CanSat 2026–2027 من وكالة الفضاء الأوروبية

deadline_note: Season kicked off 16 Sep 2026; registration deadlines set by each national competition (25+ countries); CanSat Space Engineering Summit at ESTEC 30 Jun–2 Jul 2027

summary.en: ESA's school challenge to build a satellite the size of a soft-drink can, launched by rocket or drone in national competitions across Europe and Canada. National winners attend the CanSat Space Engineering Summit at ESTEC on 30 June–2 July 2027.
summary.ka: ESA-ს სასკოლო გამოწვევა: ააწყვე გამაგრილებელი სასმლის ქილის ზომის თანამგზავრი, რომელიც ევროპისა და კანადის ეროვნულ კონკურსებზე რაკეტით ან დრონით იშვება. ეროვნული გამარჯვებულები ESTEC-ში CanSat-ის კოსმოსური ინჟინერიის სამიტს 2027 წლის 30 ივნისი–2 ივლისს ესწრებიან.
summary.ar: تحدٍّ مدرسي من وكالة الفضاء الأوروبية لبناء قمر صناعي بحجم علبة مشروب غازي، يُطلق بصاروخ أو طائرة مسيّرة في مسابقات وطنية في أوروبا وكندا. ويحضر الفائزون الوطنيون قمة CanSat لهندسة الفضاء في ESTEC من 30 يونيو إلى 2 يوليو 2027.

about.en:
In CanSat, a team of students designs and builds a mini-satellite that fits inside a can, with a primary mission (measuring air temperature and pressure during descent) and a secondary mission of their own choosing. Teams follow ESA's resources on Arduino, radio and parachutes, and launch their CanSat at a national competition.

Over 25 countries in Europe and Canada host national competitions (Latvia and Switzerland are new this year); each sets its own registration deadline, typically in the autumn. National winners join the CanSat Space Engineering Summit at ESA's technical centre.

en: Build and launch a mini-satellite
National competitions in 25+ countries
Winners go to ESA's ESTEC

eligibility.en: Secondary-school students aged 14–19 (not enrolled at university) in countries with a national CanSat competition (ESA Member States and partner countries).

en: Find your country's national CanSat competition on esa.int
Form a team with a teacher and register by the national deadline
Design, build and test your CanSat
Launch it at the national competition

costs.en: Free to participate; teams buy their own components (national organisers sometimes provide kits).

score_reason: Hands-on ESA engineering project; Europe/Canada

duration.ka: ერთჯერადი ნამუშევრის გაგზავნა, შედეგები რამდენიმე თვეში
duration.ar: تقديم عمل واحد، والنتائج بعد أشهر

deadline_note: Club-level deadlines vary by area (set by the local Optimist Club); 2026-27 topic published on the official page

summary.en: An essay contest for young people under 19 on the 2026–27 topic 'Finding My Voice in a World Full of Noise', with district-level college scholarships of $2,500. Students enter through a local Optimist Club.
summary.ka: ესეების კონკურსი 19 წლამდე ახალგაზრდებისთვის 2026–27 წლის თემაზე „ჩემი ხმის პოვნა ხმაურით სავსე სამყაროში“, ოლქის დონეზე 2,500 დოლარის საუნივერსიტეტო სტიპენდიებით. მოსწავლეები ადგილობრივი Optimist კლუბის მეშვეობით მონაწილეობენ.
summary.ar: مسابقة مقالات للشباب دون سن 19 حول موضوع 2026–27 «إيجاد صوتي في عالم مليء بالضجيج»، مع منح جامعية بقيمة 2,500 دولار على مستوى المناطق. ويشارك الطلاب عبر نادي Optimist المحلي.

about.en:
Optimist International's essay contest asks students to write an essay on the annual topic (length rules in the official contest materials). Entries are judged first at the local Optimist Club, then at district level, where winners compete for a $2,500 college scholarship funded by the Optimist International Foundations.

Optimist Clubs operate mainly in the United States, Canada and the Caribbean; deadlines are set by each club (club contests usually finish by late winter).

en: $2,500 district scholarships
Topic: 'Finding My Voice in a World Full of Noise'
Free, through local clubs

eligibility.en: Young people under 19 on 1 October 2026 who have not graduated high school, in areas served by an Optimist Club (US, Canada, Caribbean).

en: Find your local Optimist Club via optimist.org
Ask the club for its entry deadline and forms
Write your essay on the 2026–27 topic
Submit to the club before its deadline

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free essay contest with scholarships; North America

org: Bird Photographer of the Year Ltd

name.en: Young Bird Photographer of the Year 2027 (BPOTY 12)

duration.ka: ერთჯერადი ნამუშევრის გაგზავნა, შედეგები რამდენიმე თვეში
duration.ar: تقديم عمل واحد، والنتائج بعد أشهر

deadline_note: BPOTY 12 entries close 13 Dec 2026 (official homepage); youth entry is free

summary.en: The youth section of the leading international bird photography competition, free to enter for photographers aged 17 and under in three age groups. Entries close on 13 December 2026.
summary.ka: ფრინველების ფოტოგრაფიის წამყვანი საერთაშორისო კონკურსის ახალგაზრდული განყოფილება, უფასო 17 წლამდე ფოტოგრაფებისთვის სამ ასაკობრივ ჯგუფში. ნამუშევრების მიღება 2026 წლის 13 დეკემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: القسم الشبابي في أبرز مسابقة دولية لتصوير الطيور، والمشاركة مجانية للمصورين في سن 17 عامًا فأقل ضمن ثلاث فئات عمرية. ويُغلق باب المشاركة في 13 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Bird Photographer of the Year celebrates the world's best bird photography while supporting bird conservation. The youth competition has three age groups (11 and under, 12–14, 15–17); young photographers may submit up to 10 images for free.

Winning and commended images appear in the annual book and exhibition, and winners are announced in September 2027. High-resolution files are requested from shortlisted entrants in February 2027.

en: Free entry, up to 10 images
Three youth age groups
Published in the BPOTY book

eligibility.en: Photographers aged 17 and under, anywhere in the world; parental consent required.

en: Read the rules and youth categories on birdpoty.com
Create an account on the entry portal
Upload up to 10 bird photos before 13 Dec 2026

costs.en: Free for the youth competition.

score_reason: Free, global youth photo contest

name.ar: مسابقة الخطابة الدولية لاتحاد المتحدثين بالإنجليزية (ESU) 2027

deadline_note: IPSC Week 5–9 Jul 2027 in London; students enter via their country's ESU national feeder competition (national organisers register by 30 Nov 2026)

summary.en: The English-Speaking Union's international public speaking final, bringing together national champions aged 16–20 from over 40 countries in London on 5–9 July 2027. Students qualify through their country's ESU national competition.
summary.ka: English-Speaking Union-ის საერთაშორისო საჯარო გამოსვლის ფინალი, რომელიც 40-ზე მეტი ქვეყნის 16–20 წლის ეროვნულ ჩემპიონებს ლონდონში 2027 წლის 5–9 ივლისს აერთიანებს. მოსწავლეები თავიანთი ქვეყნის ESU-ს ეროვნული კონკურსის გავლით კვალიფიცირდებიან.
summary.ar: النهائي الدولي للخطابة الذي ينظمه اتحاد المتحدثين بالإنجليزية، ويجمع أبطالًا وطنيين تتراوح أعمارهم بين 16 و20 عامًا من أكثر من 40 دولة في لندن من 5 إلى 9 يوليو 2027. ويتأهل الطلاب عبر المسابقة الوطنية لاتحاد ESU في بلدهم.

about.en:
The IPSC is one of the world's most prestigious youth public-speaking contests. Each participating country's ESU runs a national feeder competition; its champion travels to London for a week of prepared and impromptu speeches, workshops and cultural activities, judged by experienced ESU judges who give feedback to everyone.

Recent winners came from Sri Lanka (2025, 2026) and France (2024). Check whether your country has an ESU branch or a recognised national organiser.

en: Champions from 40+ countries
Week of speeches and workshops in London
Feedback from expert judges

eligibility.en: Students aged 16–20 who win their country's ESU-recognised national public speaking competition.

en: Check whether your country has an ESU or recognised IPSC organiser
Enter the national feeder competition (2026–27 season)
Win the national final to be selected
Attend IPSC Week in London, 5–9 Jul 2027

costs.en: National organisers pay the participation fee; travel funding depends on the national ESU.

score_reason: Prestigious speaking final; route via national ESU

deadline_note: Local competitions early 2027; sub-regionals March; regional semifinals 6–7 Apr; regional finals 8–9 Apr; Global Final week of 10 May 2027 in Singapore. Teams enter via participating universities and local CFA societies.

summary.en: A global equity-research competition in which university teams of three to five analyse a public company, write a research report and pitch a buy/sell recommendation. The 2027 Global Final is in Singapore in the week of 10 May.
summary.ka: გლობალური კვლევითი კონკურსი, სადაც 3–5 კაციანი საუნივერსიტეტო გუნდები აანალიზებენ საჯარო კომპანიას, წერენ კვლევით ანგარიშს და წარადგენენ ყიდვის/გაყიდვის რეკომენდაციას. 2027 წლის გლობალური ფინალი სინგაპურში, 10 მაისის კვირაში ტარდება.
summary.ar: مسابقة عالمية في أبحاث الأسهم تحلل فيها فرق جامعية من ثلاثة إلى خمسة طلاب شركة مدرجة، وتكتب تقريرًا بحثيًا وتقدم توصية بالشراء أو البيع. ويُعقد النهائي العالمي لعام 2027 في سنغافورة في أسبوع 10 مايو.

about.en:
The Research Challenge gives students hands-on mentoring and training in financial analysis. Each team, guided by a faculty advisor and an industry mentor, researches an assigned company, meets its management, writes a professional equity research report and presents to a panel of investment professionals.

Winners progress from local to sub-regional, regional and global rounds (Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific). It is one of the best-known finance competitions for students targeting investment careers.

en: Real company analysis with industry mentors
Local to global rounds
Global Final in Singapore, May 2027

eligibility.en: Teams of 3–5 undergraduate or graduate students from a university participating through its local CFA society.

en: Check whether your university participates (CFA Institute site)
Form a team with a faculty advisor
Register with your local CFA society
Research the assigned company and submit the report

costs.en: Free for students; travel to later rounds is often funded by organisers/sponsors.

score_reason: Flagship finance contest; entry via universities

org: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science

duration.ar: موسم من عدة جولات على مدى أشهر

deadline_note: Regional registration opened 5 Oct 2026; coaches must submit Team 1 by 23 Nov 2026; National Finals 29 Apr–3 May 2027

summary.en: The US Department of Energy's academic quiz tournament for middle- and high-school teams in biology, chemistry, earth science, physics, energy and maths. Coaches must register their first team by 23 November 2026; finals are 29 April–3 May 2027.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის ენერგეტიკის დეპარტამენტის ინტელექტუალური ტურნირი საშუალო და უფროსი კლასების გუნდებისთვის ბიოლოგიაში, ქიმიაში, დედამიწის მეცნიერებებში, ფიზიკაში, ენერგეტიკასა და მათემატიკაში. მწვრთნელებმა პირველი გუნდი 2026 წლის 23 ნოემბრამდე უნდა დაარეგისტრირონ; ფინალი 2027 წლის 29 აპრილი–3 მაისია.
summary.ar: مسابقة الأسئلة الأكاديمية التابعة لوزارة الطاقة الأمريكية لفرق المدارس المتوسطة والثانوية في الأحياء والكيمياء وعلوم الأرض والفيزياء والطاقة والرياضيات. ويجب على المدربين تسجيل الفريق الأول بحلول 23 نوفمبر 2026، والنهائيات من 29 أبريل إلى 3 مايو 2027.

about.en:
Teams of four or five students compete in fast-paced buzzer rounds at regional competitions across the US (Jan–Mar 2027). Regional winners receive an all-expenses-paid trip to the National Finals in Washington, D.C., which also include science seminars and an engineering challenge.

It is one of the most prestigious US science academic competitions and is free to enter.

en: Free; run by the US Department of Energy
Regional winners' trip to nationals is paid
Covers all sciences plus maths

eligibility.en: Teams of 4–5 students (plus coach) from US middle and high schools; see NSB rules for citizenship/residency details.

en: Coach preregisters the school on the NSB site
Submit Team 1 registration by 23 Nov 2026
Compete at your regional event (Jan–Mar 2027)
Win to qualify for the National Finals

costs.en: Free; national finals travel paid for regional winners.

score_reason: Top US science quiz; US schools only

duration.ar: موسم من عدة جولات على مدى أشهر

deadline_note: 2027 regional bowl dates published on the official map (regional bowls Jan–Mar 2027); register with your regional coordinator

summary.en: A US high-school academic competition on ocean science, with regional bowls in early 2027 and a national finals for regional champions. Teams register through their regional bowl coordinator.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის საშუალო სკოლის ინტელექტუალური შეჯიბრი ოკეანის მეცნიერებაში, 2027 წლის დასაწყისში რეგიონული ტურნირებით და რეგიონული ჩემპიონების ეროვნული ფინალით. გუნდები რეგისტრირდებიან თავიანთი რეგიონული კოორდინატორის მეშვეობით.
summary.ar: مسابقة أكاديمية لطلاب المدارس الثانوية الأمريكية في علوم المحيطات، مع مسابقات إقليمية في أوائل 2027 ونهائيات وطنية للأبطال الإقليميين. وتسجّل الفرق عبر منسق المسابقة الإقليمية.

about.en:
NOSB tests biology, chemistry, geology, physics and policy related to the oceans through buzzer rounds and team challenge questions, plus a research-based Science Expert Briefing at nationals. Each year has a theme with dedicated study resources.

Regional bowls are hosted by universities and aquariums across the US; winners advance to the national finals, and NOSB offers scholarships to participants.

en: Ocean science quiz and briefing
Regional bowls across the US
Scholarships for participants

eligibility.en: High-school teams (US schools) of 4–5 students with a coach.

en: Check eligibility on nosb.org
Find your nearest regional bowl on the map
Contact the regional coordinator to register
Study the annual theme resources

costs.en: Usually free to participate (regional policies vary).

score_reason: Niche US science quiz

deadline_note: International final 24–30 Jul 2027 at Mount St. Mary's University; teams qualify through state/provincial Envirothons in spring 2027

summary.en: North America's largest high-school environmental education competition, with state and provincial rounds in spring and an international final at Mount St. Mary's University, Maryland, on 24–30 July 2027.
summary.ka: ჩრდილოეთ ამერიკის ყველაზე დიდი გარემოსდაცვითი საგანმანათლებლო კონკურსი საშუალო სკოლებისთვის: გაზაფხულზე შტატებისა და პროვინციების ტურებით და საერთაშორისო ფინალით Mount St. Mary's University-ში, მერილენდში, 2027 წლის 24–30 ივლისს.
summary.ar: أكبر مسابقة تعليمية بيئية لطلاب المدارس الثانوية في أمريكا الشمالية، مع جولات على مستوى الولايات والمقاطعات في الربيع ونهائي دولي في جامعة Mount St. Mary's بولاية ماريلاند من 24 إلى 30 يوليو 2027.

about.en:
Teams of five students are tested in aquatic ecology, forestry, soil and land use, wildlife and an annual current environmental issue, and give an oral presentation solving a real-world problem. State and provincial champions (US, Canada) and teams from international programmes compete at the week-long final.

Alumni describe it as a gateway to environmental careers; scholarships are awarded to top teams.

en: Field-based ecology testing
Teams from US, Canada and international programmes
Scholarships for top teams

eligibility.en: High-school teams of five that win their state/provincial or affiliated international Envirothon.

en: Find your state/provincial Envirothon programme
Form a team of five with an advisor
Compete in the spring qualifier
Win to attend the July 2027 final

costs.en: Registration fees vary by state/province; final costs often covered by sponsoring programmes.

score_reason: Strong environmental contest; North America-centred

summary.en: AAPT's 40-question, 45-minute physics exam taken in school by high-school students in the US and abroad, with awards by division and region. Registration for the 2027 contest opens in December.

about.en:
PhysicsBowl is a multiple-choice contest based on a typical high-school physics course. Division 1 is for first-year physics students and Division 2 for second-year/advanced students; schools are ranked within regions (including international regions) by their top scores.

Teachers register and proctor the exam online during the spring window. It is a good warm-up for the F=ma exam and physics olympiads.

about.en:
BioHacks 2026 is a two-day biomedical case challenge where students from health sciences, engineering and business pick a track, build a solution and pitch it to judges. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at McMaster University in Hamilton from 2026-11-07 to 2026-11-08. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.

en: Free entry, food and mentoring
Official MLH 2027 season event
Build a portfolio project in one weekend

Attend in person and submit your project for judging

Hack Cats 2026 (Hack K-State) is Kansas State University's rebranded hackathon, open to undergraduate and graduate students from any school. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at Kansas State University in Manhattan, KS from 2026-12-04 to 2026-12-06. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.

en: Free entry, food and mentoring
Official MLH 2027 season event
Build a portfolio project in one weekend

eligibility.en: Undergraduate and graduate students from any school (in-state and out-of-state); see rules for restrictions.

en: Open https://hackkstate.tech/ and sign up for application updates or apply if the form is open
Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct
Confirm your spot when accepted and arrange your own travel unless reimbursement is offered
Attend in person and submit your project for judging

costs.en: Free to attend; meals, snacks and workspace provided. Travel and accommodation are usually at your own cost unless the event announces travel reimbursement.

score_reason: Free MLH hackathon with registration open now

about.en:
The Student Academy Awards, run by the organisation behind the Oscars, have launched the careers of many acclaimed directors. Entrants must be post-secondary students in a degree or certificate programme whose film (up to 40 minutes) was made as part of coursework.

Winning films become eligible for Oscar consideration in the short film categories, and winners are honoured at an awards ceremony (2026's was held at TIFF Lightbox, Toronto). One film per director per year; entry is free.

en: Free, open to film students worldwide
Four categories incl. animation and documentary
Winners eligible for Oscar shorts consideration

eligibility.en: Directors who are post-secondary students in a degree or certificate programme when the film was made; film made as coursework, max 40 minutes, completed within the eligibility window; one entry per director.

en: Check the 2027 rules when published on oscars.org/saa
Prepare your coursework film and supporting documents
Submit online during the spring window

costs.en: Free to enter.

score_reason: Prestigious free film award; dates expected spring

Castor Informatique is a 45-minute online contest of interactive puzzles about algorithms, logic and data, requiring no prior programming knowledge. Teachers register as coordinators and run the contest with their classes at any time during the window; results and certificates follow.

The contest is in French; students can continue learning programming on France-ioi.org.
